definitions: A cunning or skilful act or scheme intended to deceive or outwit someone.
A practical joke or mischievous act.
A successful stratagem or a clever way of doing something.
The cards played in a single round of a card game, constituting one unit for scoring.
examples: He played a trick on his sister.
It's a trick of the light.
She has a trick of biting her lip.
The magician performed a card trick.
There's a trick to opening this jar.
